errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the orange line outlines the blue filled area. In the chart, the orange line represents "Ръст" (Growth) in percentages and is a separate data series plotted above the blue area, which represents the "B2B пазар" (B2B market) in trillion dollars. The orange line does not define the boundary of the blue area.
